reference_phase.scope: Independent generated-fixture preparation only, with its own separately recorded elapsed time and explicit Root-selected deadline up to 300 seconds. Root executed this once; complete proof 1a3e47ec28b1f96c4ac0d5c9c9eb7c2f13288cf5a6df4e3c4f6853d07a56aa03 records 3,991,999,872 bytes and 198 checkpoints. The producer helper must consume that exact proof, never repeat reference preparation.
reference_phase.hash_checkpoints: Sorted unique positive size values; exact numeric count and copied digests are frozen in the reference proof before any producer run. No unrelated target path/role/digest is read or inherited.
reference_phase.recipe: One continuous periodic00..ff prefix stream. At each distinct declared length use SHA256.copy().hexdigest(). Partial-block continuation uses position modulo the shared1MiB block; never restart at00 at an arbitrary checkpoint.
reference_phase.producer_gate: Partial reference outputs have no complete descriptors and must be refused. Root separately pins and authorizes the complete reference result.

producer_phase.binding_source_map: Exact pause.sources equality, then explicit paused own_module_order and MODULES order; JSON key order is not authority. Byte/hash plus resolved-path equality checks stability, never relative-versus-absolute text equality.
producer_phase.clock: Capture a real monotonic sample at helper entry. Return that original sample ONCE as the actual injected owner start, then return real monotonic samples thereafter. Source origin/work/hard must equal original entry/+295/+300. This is captured-sample adoption for an injected component, not production first-entry/Origin/FFI qualification.
producer_phase.binding_policy: New fictional D:\FictionalRoleAwareLarge paths only; actual source-owned read buffer filled using 256B seed plus generic source buffer_write_slice/copy_within doubling. Independent delivered counters derive each request; no subject counter is an oracle and no bulk body is retained.
producer_phase.independent_consumer: Every fixed file/call/module row and edge, the complete raw header, every original path/name byte, and each of the 648 query frames are visited. Query comparisons use one <=8202B frame and memoryview slices, including comparison with actual canonical query bytes. No full query pool copy or hex. Healthy candidate has 9,879 calls; terminal has 10,095. Rejection or incomplete consumption prevents PASS.
producer_phase.spy_format: 64-byte little-endian <IHHQQQddIIQ rows: ordinal, file ordinal, API1..7, request, count, scalar, actual entry, return-preparation time, independent read generation, flags, handle. Flags 1/2/4/8 are invocation entry, scalar hook completed, count hook completed, normal return prepared. They do not replace first-assignment observedness or measure the caller's receipt. Actual canonical c.wrapper_return/c.wrapper_state and raw facts are checked separately for every ledger call. All seven full argument dictionaries are checked at dispatch; fixed constants and ordinal descriptors make the compact log reconstructible.
producer_phase.failed_prefix_raw_evidence: ROLE-AWARE-LARGE-RAW-SIDECAR-FORMAT-v1.json fixes the bounded cold streaming sidecar over ALL existing canonical registry records, including reserved/uninvoked. Actual sentinel/NULL/zero scalar/count/error/definition and hash/copy/helper/wrapper/clock/fold/stop axes survive missing ledgers. Actual immutable query captures stream to a bounded sidecar; no bulk buffer is copied, no owner method or new clock is invoked, and no full call-dict list is assembled.
producer_phase.sink_observation: Callbacks record ACK supplied/return prepared. Actual source return_observed/acknowledged facts are copied separately after the subject stack unwinds. A late veto never becomes a claimed normal callback return. Legal once-only cleanup of actually opened handles is retained after a failed work prefix.
producer_phase.retention: Keep actual complete issued candidate/terminal bytes and complete call/query/close evidence. Persist bounded artifacts after source returns rather than duplicating bulk/query/journal hex in the JSON proof. Harness metadata/temporary storage is reported separately; RSS remains unknown.
producer_phase.first_result: One exclusive attempt and immutable terminal proof, including timeout/failure/unknown suffix. No repeat merely for favorable timing. No hard callback-free hang guarantee without a separately owned watchdog.
